personalInfo.name: Roberto Abad Ramirez Nieves
personalInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer
personalInfo.description: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable, high-impact digital products across mobile and web platforms. Strong background in iOS, modern frontend architectures, API integration, and enterprise-grade applications used by millions of users.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a software engineer focused on building reliable, scalable, and well-crafted digital products in complex and high-impact environments, including banking, enterprise platforms, and consumer-facing applications.

My experience spans across native iOS development, modern frontend technologies, and backend service integration, allowing me to contribute beyond feature delivery — from architecture discussions and system design to performance, accessibility, and long-term maintainability.

I thrive in collaborative environments where technology, product, and design intersect, and I am known for adapting quickly to new stacks and domains while maintaining a strong engineering mindset focused on quality, clarity, and user value.
